purpose: Teach: 宮内/市況/愛さ/べし/つた/こく/まぜ/混ざっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お味の濃くなった煮物、お客様に伝った、絶対お気に入りです。お父さん、宮内庁の方ともお仕事をされたぞ
lines.en: Your father's dishes grew richer in flavor, you know. The customers absolutely loved them. And he worked with people from the Imperial Household Office.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried reminiscence. Gentle pride in the voice. Speaks as though sharing a quiet truth with someone who will understand it. No rush to the next thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは市況を読む眼力をお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. Father had a remarkable eye for reading the market.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Steady tone, measured pace. The weight of acknowledged skill — not flattery, but accurate recognition. Slight pause before speaking, as if honoring the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員を愛されるご性格だったぞ
lines.en: Your father was the kind of man who truly cared for his employees.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze in the voice. Speaking from long memory. Gentle cadence, like turning over something precious. A slight catch of affection on 'truly cared.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは「誠であるべし」と教えてくださいました
lines.en: Yes. Father always taught me: 'You must act with sincerity.'
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reciting a lesson learned so deeply it lives in him now. Gentle emphasis on the principle itself. Voice carries the weight of inheritance, not burden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは「信用を継ぐべし」とおっしゃった
lines.en: Your father used to say: 'You must inherit that trust.'
lines.style: Quieter here. Speaking as though Father's voice still echoes slightly. Reverent, specific — the exact words matter. A long breath underneath, holding the responsibility gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが築かれた信用を継ぐべく日々励んでおります
lines.en: Yes. Every day I work to inherit the trust Father built.
lines.style: Steady commitment, no wavering. Quiet determination. The words carry weight but aren't burdened by it — this is his daily practice, his offering. Slow, intentional pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員を信頼してまぜて配置されたぞ
lines.en: Your father trusted people enough to place them across different departments, mixing backgrounds and perspectives.
lines.style: Admiring tone. Speaking of a wisdom that was ahead of its time. Slow unfold of the idea. Recognition that this took both trust and vision — not just kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。複数部門が混ざったプロジェクトを推進しております
lines.en: Yes. I continue to lead cross-departmental projects with that same approach in mind.
lines.style: Calm certainty. Speaking as heir to a practice. Not defensive, not self-congratulatory — simply stating what he carries forward. Quiet closure, like setting something in its place.
